run: client loop, 1800 s, 6-tile padi plant -> ready -> harvest -> sell pasar -> buy padi 1, with ALL 8 LookDev candidates applied
studio: Development-Juragan-Desa, placeId 132087524375529, Play Solo, harness in-memory
freshProfileMethod: VERIFY-TEMP store.Mock in-memory ProfileStore in src/server/Data/PlayerData.luau, reverted before commit
probe: injected SoakProbe LocalScript in PlayerScripts (real require cache); writes ReplicatedStorage.SoakData folder attributes every 5 cycles and at done; server-side LookDevWalkin enabled from an injected Script

allCandidatesOn.method: LookDev is single-active, so the eight disjoint appliers were applied additively: six client adapters (.apply directly) + plaza_lighting via LookDev.enable on Client + police_walkin via LookDev.enable on Server

lastFailure.harvest: harvest refused on tile 6 (empty, still growing, or the sack is full)
lastFailure.buy: shop refused padi x1 (stock, rank or cash)

failureInterpretation: Expected graceful refusals, not defects: the probe buys only 1 padi per cycle but attempts 6 plants, so seed stock runs dry by design; harvest/sell refusals follow. Same class as the 2026-11-19 regression-replay soak.

memory.clientSource: Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() sampled in the real LocalScript VM at start and after every cycle
memory.serverSource: Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() read separately in the Server datamodel at start and end
memory.verdict: No leak. Both memory series end below their start; the one large mid-run drop is GC compaction, and the post-GC drift is ~11 MB over 180 cycles decelerating to ~3 MB over the final 40 cycles (a plateau, not unbounded growth).

census.source: whole-DataModel BasePart/Instance count from the real LocalScript VM every 5 cycles, plus a post-soak stability sample
census.connectionProxies: Roblox exposes no raw RBXScriptConnection counter. Stuck-reply proxy = harness pending queue (always 0); lifecycle proxy = DataModel instance/part count and LookDev-owned containers. The appliers that register signals (npcs, walkin) create them once at apply and disconnect once at restore.
census.verdict: No growth signal. +163 instances / +134 parts over 1800 s (~0.09 instances/s) that decelerate to +2 instances / +0 parts over the ~993 s after the soak loop stopped — a plateau. Zero crop parts persisted on tiles; the pending harness queue never grew (no stuck/orphaned replies).

economy.verdict: No desync symptom: cash and lifetimeEarned advanced coherently, tilesOwned constant at 6, rank progressed gurem -> petani, tutorial advanced to step 5. An explicit client/server state diff was not scripted this run (same limitation as the regression-replay soak).

outputLog: Zero game-code errors or warnings across the full 1801 s soak. Lines are the known external ones: a ProfileStore availability notice, three rbxassetid://203785492 asset-type warnings, AnalyticsService event notices, and probe self-destroy parent warnings. BUG-003 did not recur.
